arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَتْبَاعُ الرُّسُلِ وَمُصَدِّقُوهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الاَرْضِ بِالْغَيْبِ عِنْدَ مُعَارَضَةِ الْمُعَـانِدينَ لَهُمْ بِالتَّكْذِيبِ وَالاشْتِيَاقِ إلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ بِحَقائِقِ الايْمَانِ .
transliteration: allāhumma wa atbāʿu al-rusuli wa muṣaddiqūhum min ahli al-arḍi bil-ghaybi ʿinda muʿāradhati al-muʿānidīna lahum bi al-takdhibi wa al-ishtiyāqi ilā al-mursalīna bi ḥaqāʾiqi al-īmān
english_text: O God, as for the followers of the messengers and those of the people of the earth who attested to them unseen (while the obstinate resisted them through crying lies) - they yearned for the emissaries through the realities of faith

arabic_text: فِي كُلِّ دَهْر وَزَمَان أَرْسَلْتَ فِيْهِ رَسُولاً، وَأَقَمْتَ لاهْلِهِ دَلِيلاً، مِنْ لَدُنْ آدَمَ إلَى مُحَمَّد صَلَّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِـهِ مِنْ أَئِمَّةِ الْهُـدَى، وَقَادَةِ أَهْـلِ التُّقَى عَلَى جَمِيعِهِمُ السَّلاَمُ، فَاذْكُرْهُمْ مِنْكَ بِمَغْفِرَة وَرِضْوَان.
transliteration: fī kulli dahri wa zamān arsalta fīhi rasūlan, wa aqamta li-ahlīhi dalīlan min ladun adam ila muhammadin salla allahu 'alayhi wa alihi min aimmati al-huda wa qādati ahl al-taqwá ʿalá jamīʿihimu al-salām fa dh kurhum mink bimaghfirah wa ridhwan
english_text: in every era and time in which Thou didst send a messenger and set up for the people a director from the period of Adam down to Muhammad (God bless him and his Household) from among the imams of guidance and the leaders of the godfearing (upon them all be peace) - remember them with forgiveness and good pleasure!

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّد خَاصَّةً الَّـذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا الصَّحَابَةَ، وَالَّذِينَ أَبْلَوْا الْبَلاَءَ الْحَسَنَ فِي نَصْرِهِ، وَكَانَفُوهُ وَأَسْرَعُوا إلَى وِفَادَتِهِ وَسَابَقُوا إلَى دَعْوَتِهِ واسْتَجَابُوا لَهُ حَيْثُ أَسْمَعَهُمْ حجَّةَ رِسَالاَتِهِ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa asḥābu muḥammad khāṣṣatan alladhīna aḥsanū aṣ-ṣaḥābah wa allaḏīna ablaw al-balāʾa al-ḥasan fī naṣrih wa kāna fūhu wa asraʿū ilā wifādatihi wa sābaqū ilā daʿwatih wa-istajābū lahū ḥaythu asmahum ḥajjata risālātih
english_text: O God, and as for the Companions of Muhammad specifically, those who did well in companionship, who stood the good test in helping him, who surrounded him in support, hastened to present themselves before him, and vied with one another in responding to his call responded to him when he made them hear his messages' argument,

arabic_text: وَفَارَقُوا الازْوَاجَ وَالاوْلادَ فِي إظْهَارِ كَلِمَتِهِ، وَقَاتَلُوا الاباءَ وَ الابناءَ فِي تَثْبِيتِ نبُوَّتِهِ، وَانْتَصَرُوا بهِ وَمَنْ كَانُوا مُنْطَوِينَ عَلَى مَحبَّتِهِ يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَنْ تَبُورَ فِي مَوَدَّتِهِ،
transliteration: wa-fāraqū al-azwāja wal-awlāda fī iẓhāri kalimatihi wa qātalu al'abā'a wa al'abnā'a fī tathbīti nubuwwatih wa antaṣarū bihī waman kānū munṭawīnan ʿalā maḥabbatihī yarjūna tijāratan lan tabūra fī mawaddatih
english_text: separated from mates and children in manifesting his word, fought against fathers and sons in strengthening his prophecy, and through him gained victory; those who were wrapped in affection for him, "hoping for a commerce that comes not to naught" (35:29) in love for him;

arabic_text: وَالّذينَ هَجَرَتْهُمُ العَشَائِرُ إذْ تَعَلَّقُوا بِعُرْوَتِهِ، وَانْتَفَتْ مِنْهُمُ الْقَرَاباتُ إذْ سَكَنُوا فِي ظلِّ قَرَابَتِهِ
transliteration: wa alladhīna hajaraṯhumu alʿashāʾiru idh taʿallaqū biʿurwatihim wa 'intafat minhum al-qarābātu idh sakanū fī ẓilli qarābatih
english_text: those who were left by their clans when they clung to his handhold and denied by their kinsfolk when they rested in the shadow of his kinship;

arabic_text: فَلاَ تَنْسَ لَهُمُ اللّهُمَّ مَا تَرَكُوا لَكَ وَفِيكَ، وَأَرْضِهِمْ مِنْ رِضْوَانِكَ وَبِمَا حَاشُوا الْخَلْقَ عَلَيْكَ، وَكَانُوا مَعَ رَسُولِكَ دُعَاةً لَكَ إلَيْكَ،
transliteration: fala tantass lahumu allahumma ma tarakuwa laka wa feeka wa-arḍihim min riḍwānik wa-bimā ḥāshū al-khalq ʿalayk wa kānū maʿa rasūlika duʿātan laka ilayk
english_text: forget not, O God, what they abandoned for Thee and in Thee, and make them pleased with Thy good pleasure for the sake of the creatures they drove to Thee while they were with Thy Messenger, summoners to Thee for Thee.

arabic_text: وَاشكُرْهُمْ عَلَى هَجْرِهِمْ فِيْكَ دِيَارَ قَوْمِهِمْ، وَخُرُوجِهِمْ مِنْ سَعَةِ الْمَعَاشِ إلَى ضِيْقِهِ، وَمَنْ كَثَّرْتَ فِي إعْزَازِ دِيْنِـكَ مِنْ مَظْلُومِهِمْ.
transliteration: wa ashkurhum ʿalā hajrihim fīka diyār qawmihim wa khurujihim min sa'ati al-ma'ashi ila dhiqih wa man kathart(a) fī iʿzāzi dīnik(a) min maẓlūmihim
english_text: Show gratitude to them for leaving the abodes of their people for Thy sake and going out from a plentiful livelihood to a narrow one, and [show gratitude to] those of them who became objects of wrongdoing and whom Thou multiplied in exalting Thy religion.

arabic_text: ألّهُمَّ وَأوْصِلْ إلَى التَّابِعِينَ لَهُمْ بِإحْسَان الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ : رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلاخْوَانِنَا الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقُونَا بِالاِيمَانِ خَيْرَ جَزَائِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa awsil ilā at-tābiʿīna lahum bi-iḥsān alladhīna yaqūlūna: rabbana ighfir lana wa-li-ikhwani-nalladhina sabaquna bi-al-imaani khayra jaza'ika
english_text: O God, and give to those who have done well in following the Companions, who say, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who went before us in faith" (59:10), Thy best reward;

arabic_text: الَّذِينَ قَصَدُوا سَمْتَهُمْ، وَتَحَرَّوْا وِجْهَتَهُمْ، وَمَضَوْا عَلى شاكِلَتِهِمْ،
transliteration: al-ladhīna qaṣadū samtahum, wa ṭaharraw wajhatahum, wa madhaw ʿalā shākilatihim
english_text: those who went straight to the Companions' road, sought out their course, and proceeded in their manner.

arabic_text: لَمْ يَثْنِهِمْ رَيْبٌ فِي بَصِيْرَتِهِمْ، وَلَمْ يَخْتَلِجْهُمْ شَكٌّ فِي قَفْوِ آثَارِهِمْ وَالاِئْتِمَامِ بِهِدَايَةِ مَنَارِهِمْ،
transliteration: lam yathnihim raybun fi basiratihim, walam yakhtalijhum shakkun fī qafwi āthārihim walāitmāmi bihidāyati manārihim،
english_text: No doubt concerning their sure insight diverted them and no uncertainty shook them from following in their tracks and being led by the guidance of their light.

arabic_text: مُكَانِفِينَ وَمُوَازِرِيْنَ لَهُمْ، يَدِيْنُونَ بِدِيْنِهِمْ، وَيَهْتَدُونَ بِهَدْيِهِمْ، يَتَّفِقُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَلاَ يَتَّهِمُونَهُمْ فِيمَا أدَّوْا إلَيْهِمْ.
transliteration: mukānifīna wa muwāzirīna lahum, yadīnūna bidīnihim, wa yahtadūna bihadyihim yattafiqūna ʿalayhim, walā yattahimūnahum fīmā addawū ilayhim
english_text: As their assistants and supporters, they professed their religion, gained guidance through their guidance, came to agreement with them, and never accused them in what they passed on to them.

arabic_text: ألَّلهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى التّابِعِيْنَ مِنْ يَوْمِنَا هَذا إلى يَوْم الدِّينِ، وَعَلَى أزْوَاجِهِمْ، وَعَلَى ذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ، وَعَلَى مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ مِنْهُمْ صَلاْةً تَعْصِمُهُمْ بِهَامِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ، وَتَفْسَحُ لَهُمْ فِي رِيَاضِ جَنَّتِكَ، وَتَمْنَعُهُمْ بِهَا مِنْ كَيْدِ الشَيْطَانِ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa ṣalli ʿalā al-tābiʿīna min yawminā hādhā ilá yawm al-dīn wa ʿalā azwājihim, wa ʿalā dhurriyyātihim wa ʿalā man aṭāʿaka minhum ṣalātan taʿṣimuhum bihāmīn maʿṣiyatik wa tafsahu lahum fi riyaḍi jannatika, wa tamnaʿuhum biha min kaydi al-shayṭan
english_text: O God, and bless the Followers, from this day of ours to the Day of Doom, their wives, their offspring, and those among them who obey Thee, with a blessing through which Thou wilt preserve them from disobeying Thee, make room for them in the plots of Thy Garden, defend them from the trickery of Satan,

arabic_text: وَتُعِينُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى مَا اسْتَعَانُوكَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بِرٍّ، وَتَقِيهِمْ طَوَارِقَ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ إلاّ طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْر، وَتَبْعَثُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى اعْتِقَادِ حُسْنِ الرَّجَـاءِ لَكَ، وَالطَّمَعِ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ، وَتَرْكِ النُّهَمَةِ فِيمَا تَحْويهِ
transliteration: wa tuʿīnuhum bihā ʿalā mā istaʿānūka ʿalayhi min birrin wa taqīhim ṭawāriqa allayli wan-nahāri illā ṭāriqan yatruqu bikhayr wa tabʿathuhum biha ʿalā iʿtiqād husni al-rajaʾi laka wa al-tamaʿi fi ma ʿindaka, wa tarki al-nuhmata fi ma tahwiih
english_text: help them in the piety in which they seek help from Thee, protect them from sudden events that come by night and day - except the events which come with good - and incite them to tie firmly the knot of good hope in Thee, desire what is with Thee, and refrain from ill thoughts [toward Thee] because of what

arabic_text: أيْدِي الْعِبَادِ لِتَرُدَّهُمْ إلَى الرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ وَالرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ، وَتُزَهِّدُهُمْ فِي سَعَةِ العَاجِلِ وَتُحَبِّبُ إلَيْهِمُ الْعَمَلَ لِلاجِلِ، وَالاسْتِعْدَادَ لِمَا بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَتُهَوِّنَ عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّ كَرْب يَحُلُّ بِهِمْ يَوْمَ خُـرُوجِ الانْفُسِ مِنْ أَبْدَانِهَا
transliteration: 'aydi al-'ibadi litarddahum ila al-raghbati ilayka wal-rrahbati minka wa tuzahhiduhum fi sa'ati al-'ajili wa tuhabbibu ilayhimu al-ʿamalal-lilajli, wāl-istiʿdāda limā baʿdal-mawti watu-hawwina ʿalayhim kullu karbin yahullu bihim yawma khurooji al-anfusi min abdaniha
english_text: the hands of Thy servants' hold. Thus Thou mayest restore them to beseeching Thee and fearing Thee, induce them to renounce the plenty of the immediate, make them love to work for the sake of the deferred and prepare for what comes after death, make easy for them every distress that comes to them on the day when souls take leave from bodies,

arabic_text: وَتُعَافِيَهُمْ مِمَّا تَقَعُ بِهِ الْفِتْنَةُ مِنْ مَحْذُورَاتِهَا، وَكَبَّةِ النَّارِ وَطُولِ الْخُلُودِ فِيهَا، وَتُصَيِّرَهُمْ إلَى أَمْن مِنْ مَقِيلِ الْمُتَّقِينَ .
transliteration: wa tuʿāfiyahum mimmā taqaʿu bihi al-fitnatu min maḥḏūrātihā wa kabbaṭi al-nāri wa ṭūli al-khulūdi fīhā wa tusaʿyirahum ila amnin min maqil al-muttaqin
english_text: release them from that which brings about the perils of temptation and being thrown down in the Fire and staying forever within it, and take them to security, the resting place of the godfearing.
